title: Rename Contact to ChatContact and update method names
description:
The I-D names the type ChatContact throughout, with methods ChatContact/{get,set,changes,query,queryChanges}. The codebase uses Contact/{get,set,changes,query}.

Files to touch:
- kith-core/src/contact.rs: rename struct Contact to ChatContact
- kith-core/src/lib.rs: re-exports
- kith-store/src/contact.rs: type references
- kith-chat/src/: rename handler structs, add missing ChatContact/queryChanges method
- kith-jmap/src/lib.rs: METHOD_ROLES table entries, state-change event type name Contact -> ChatContact
